purpose: Rebuild research tools after a disposable computer wipe; not resume lost simulations.

fallback.note: Remote reconstruction preserves the repaired source tree; offline bundle preserves original commit history.

build.two_punctures: Bundled in Dendro-GR/BSSN_GR. tpid is a CMake target, not a separate repository.

python.lock_kind: Exact package versions without wheel hashes; requires package registry access.

platform.tested: Debian 13 amd64 with GCC 14, OpenMPI 5.0.7 runtime, BLAS/LAPACK runtimes
platform.local_apt: Restricted to that base; exact signed Debian package versions plus SHA256.

limitations: Pins freeze this known research state, not the latest upstream main.
No credentials, shell dotfiles, or global Git identity copied.
Old simulation outputs/checkpoints are not contained in this setup bundle.
Native compiler optimization is host-specific; rebuild on each CPU.
Only pynwave2d source is bundled; public Dendro and dependency commits require GitHub access.
Scientific validity, convergence, and long evolutions are not established by installation tests.
